summary.name: 舒心图
summary.one_liner: 舒心图 is a Chinese-language emotional-recovery web page that asks how you feel, offers travel-style recommendations, and shares short "Chronicles" stories about calming experiences.
use_cases: check in on current mood and emotional state
read short stories about calming travel experiences
practice a simple breathing exercise during panic or anxiety
get AI-based travel destination suggestions within a budget
find inspiration for a solo trip or city break
summary.what_it_does: The page opens with a prompt asking the visitor how they feel and invites them to identify their current inner state. It offers an AI recommendation feature ("AI 命定推荐") that suggests destinations based on a resource budget, such as ¥5,000. A "Chronicles · 情绪纪实" section shows short first-person style stories tied to places like Kyoto, Taipei, Huangshan and Lisbon, each with a single reflective line. One included item is a breathing reset protocol (4 seconds in, 6 seconds out). The page also includes a prompt to join a community to unlock all stories.
notable: AI travel recommendation tied to mood and budget
Short reflective travel stories by location
caveats: Community sign-up appears to be needed to unlock all stories
Page is largely marketing copy with few concrete technical details
Pricing and full feature set are not stated
